name: Abruzzo
summary: A crimson field with the regional arms: a shield divided diagonally into white, green and blue, standing for the region's mountains, hills and sea. The 2023 version adds the Warrior of Capestrano, an ancient Italic statue.
origin: Abruzzo's arms were set by regional law in 1986 and the flag in 1999. A law of 27 December 2023 modified the design.

colors.name: White
colors.meaning: The snowy peaks of the Apennines.

symbols.name: Tricolour shield
symbols.description: White, green and blue diagonal bands.
symbols.meaning: Mountains, hills and sea, ordered by distance from the coast.

symbols.name: Warrior of Capestrano
symbols.description: A 6th-century BC limestone statue of a warrior with a wide hat.

facts: Abruzzo holds the highest peaks of the Apennines, including the Corno Grande.
Its three national parks led to the nickname 'the greenest region in Europe'.
clues: Crimson with a diagonal white, green and blue shield.
Its shield maps mountains, hills and sea.
An ancient warrior statue appears on the latest version.
